labels.name: upstream
labels.rationale: Advisory concerns a dependency (Pygments), not Rich's own code

body:
This advisory concerns a dependency of Rich (Pygments, and `requests` in the pip-audit output), not Rich's own code, so it has been labelled `upstream`. Please report the Pygments issue to the Pygments project, and use the private route in [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md) for any vulnerability report that concerns Rich itself.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
